```plato

    // True when the matrix has an inverse: the determinant is a real number and
    // no smaller in magnitude than Number.Epsilon, the same threshold Invert uses.
    CanInvert(self: Matrix4x4): Boolean {
        var det = self.Determinant;
        return !det.IsNaN && det.Abs >= Number.Epsilon;
    }
```
